Additional details in the fatal Culver CityBus shooting have emerged, including the identities of the victim and the suspected gunman.

The shooting occurred Thursday evening in Mar Vista and claimed the life of bus driver Bruce Rodriguez, a 42-year-old man whose family remembered his dedication to his loved ones, including his parents and his two sons, a 3-year-old and a 6-month-old.

“Bruce served his community from behind the wheel. The role he loved most was at home, where he got to be a husband and a dad,” Kathy Sanchez, Rodriguez’s sister-in-law, said in the description of a GoFundMe campaign seeking aid for his survivors.

Driver’s wild story falls apart after police K9 sniffs out the truth

A California driver’s story apparently had more twists than a crime thriller, but one four-legged cop wasn’t buying it.

The Alhambra Police Department announced Saturday that a routine traffic stop in Alhambra turned into a massive drug bust after police K9 Otis allegedly sniffed out roughly 200 kilos — about 440 pounds — of cocaine stuffed inside an SUV.

And before cops made the jaw-dropping discovery, police said the driver offered up a couple of explanations about why he was cruising around with an SUV overflowing with mysterious cardboard boxes.
